description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for capturing, processing, and managing role-based snapshots of UI elements, including handling interactive and structural roles, reference management, and snapshot compacting.

classes.name: RoleRef
classes.description: Type representing a reference to a role with optional name and index.

classes.name: RoleRefMap
classes.description: Type alias for a record mapping string keys to RoleRef objects.

classes.name: RoleSnapshotStats
classes.description: Type representing statistics about a role snapshot, including line, character, reference, and interactivity counts.

classes.name: RoleSnapshotOptions
classes.description: Type for options controlling snapshot generation, such as filtering by interactivity, depth, and compactness.

methods.name: getRoleSnapshotStats
methods.description: Calculates and returns statistics for a given snapshot and its references.

methods.name: buildRoleSnapshotFromAriaSnapshot
methods.description: Generates a role snapshot and reference map from an ARIA snapshot string, with options for filtering and compacting.

methods.name: buildRoleSnapshotFromAiSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a role snapshot from Playwright's AI snapshot output, preserving self-resolving refs.

methods.name: parseRoleRef
methods.description: Parses a raw role reference string into a normalized reference ID if valid.
